policy.OK: low-risk enough to leave focused repair and enter bulk audit
policy.Fix: concrete yomi error repairable from available unit/context
policy.Ambiguous: target Japanese but no safe correction from available unit/context
policy.Skip: non-target text excluded from yomi repair

notes: This is a reviewable draft, not final gold.
Existing first-pass Review rows were visually inspected by label source and note.
Known/synthetic concrete reading-error Review rows were labeled Fix.
Targeted unresolved ambiguity rows were labeled Ambiguous; these include 辛い plus non-辛い examples such as 方, 市場, and 人気.
Some theoretically ambiguous but practically resolved readings, such as この方が自然だと思います, are labeled OK rather than Ambiguous.
Original first-pass labels are preserved as first_pass_expected_status.
